about:
.MC is a country-code top-level domain (ccTLD) in the DNS root zone. It is designated for Monaco. The IANA root zone lists the registry manager as Direction des Plateformes et des Ressources Numériques. Registration policies (who may register, local presence, pricing) are set by the registry and its accredited registrars — not by IANA.

.mc is the Internet country code top-level domain (ccTLD) for the Principality of Monaco. Registrations are made directly at the second level and require a company registration in Monaco. Registration for individuals is not allowed. Domains need to have a minimum length of 3 characters and no unicode domains are possible.
whoCanRegister: Eligibility is defined by the registry operator and its registrars. Most gTLDs are open to anyone worldwide. Many ccTLDs are also open globally; some require local presence, citizenship, or trademark rights. Always confirm current policy with the registry or your registrar.
